title: Nail the Narrative
author: Martin Fowler (martin@martinfowler.com)
description: Sumeet Gayathri Moghe finds many folks building presentations get tangled in building slides without a coherent narrative. He advises distilling the big idea, visualizing the audience, and building a structured storyline. more…
